scope: value-domain descriptions appended to the schema packets; graph read in READ sessions, relational exports opened read-only

threshold.rule: Kneedle knee of the empirical CDF of log10(distinct values) over every (WG, owner, name) of both languages; the pooled knee is used for both languages

labelLengthCap.rule: Kneedle knee of the empirical CDF of log10(longest value length) over every string (WG, owner, name) of both languages with at most threshold distinct (element) values; longer low-cardinality strings get a format description instead of a full list, and examples are cut at this length

leakSet.rule: examples exclude values equal to or containing (word-boundary) any gold cell or anchor key of the 667 items, and values occurring (word-boundary) in any question text

namespaceWord.rule: the namespace word between w3id.org/ (or its digit-masked shape w9id.org/) and # in the graph's own IRIs is replaced by <ns> in the appended text; the original packets do not contain it
